I am a farmer here in Kigoma with my maize plot of about one hectare. The rains come once a year and I rely on them, there is no irrigation on my land. Fertilizer is expensive and not always available in our area, so I use mostly manure from my animals and save what little money I have for seed and food. I usually plant the local maize seed I keep from last harvest, and my family does most of the weeding ourselves, though I hire a few extra hands for land preparation and weeding when the grass grows fast.
